brief:
A security guard testified in court that he "felt like Indiana Jones" during a break-in at an Elbit Systems arms factory near Bristol in 2024, according to Middle East Eye. Five defendants face charges in connection with the incident at the weapons manufacturer's facility.

The guard's characterization emerged as part of court proceedings against those accused in the case, which involved Palestine Action activists.
dek: Security guard in Palestine Action case tells court he ‘felt like Indiana Jones’ Submitted by Katherine Hearst on Fri, 10/09/2026 - 15:01 Five defendants are facing charges in connection with a break-in at an Elbit Systems arms factory near Bristol in 2024…
title: Security guard describes Elbit factory break-in as Indiana Jones adventure
